text: Why do the poor keep getting poorer, while the rich just keep getting richer?
Look at a normal guy. Benny works hard, and he saves his money in a bank account.
But the Fed keeps creating billions of new dollars.
That creates inflation. Groceries cost more. Rent goes up. His saved cash loses value every single day.
But Rich Benny is smart. He knows saving cash is a trap.
So Rich Benny does the exact opposite. He walks into the bank and borrows a million dollars.
He uses that debt to buy a real asset: an apartment building.
Now watch what inflation does to Rich Benny.
As more money gets created, his building goes up in value. And he can raise the rent on his tenants.
But here's the secret. His million-dollar fixed-rate loan stays exactly the same.
Inflation makes normal Benny's savings worth less and less.
But it makes Rich Benny's debt cheaper, while his assets get more valuable.
The poor save paper money. The rich borrow paper money to buy the real world.
Want to be as smart as Rich Benny? Follow.
